description: This file provides type annotations (stub definitions) for the '_distributed_autograd' module in PyTorch, including class definitions, function signatures, and imported modules.

classes.name: DistAutogradContext
classes.description: Represents a context for distributed autograd, with methods to access context ID, associated functions, and worker IDs.

methods.name: _context_id
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this autograd context.

methods.name: _recv_functions
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping integers to 'Any' representing receive functions.

methods.name: _send_functions
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping integers to 'Any' representing send functions.

methods.name: _known_worker_ids
methods.description: Returns a set of worker IDs involved in this context.

methods.name: _new_context
methods.description: Creates a new distributed autograd context and returns it.

methods.name: _release_context
methods.description: Releases the specified autograd context by its ID.

methods.name: _get_max_id
methods.description: Returns the maximum context ID currently in use.

methods.name: _is_valid_context
methods.description: Checks if the given worker ID corresponds to a valid context.

methods.name: _retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves the autograd context associated with the given context ID.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the distributed autograd system with a given worker ID.

methods.name: _get_debug_info
methods.description: Returns debugging information as a dictionary.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Performs backpropagation on a list of root tensors within the specified context.

methods.name: get_gradients
methods.description: Retrieves gradients for tensors in a given autograd context.
